status_label: Unvalidated pilot. Unreviewed. Shown whether or not it beats the calendar.
model_kind_note: Calendar model: day of year and place only. It knows nothing about this year's weather.
sighting_chance_meaning: Sighting chance: the chance chanterelles are reported in this weather cell this week, given at least one fungal observation of any kind there that week (D12). It is not the chance mushrooms are present, and not the chance you will find them.
regions_note: No ecoregion is published under D5 (published only after beating the calendar on held-out years). The owner asked for this pilot to be shown regardless (Forager RECORD -814).
attribution: GBIF.org (6 October 2026) GBIF Occurrence Download https://doi.org/10.15468/dl.8jxmeb.
attribution_details: GBIF.org (6 October 2026) GBIF Occurrence Download https://doi.org/10.15468/dl.8jxmeb. Occurrence records from 26 datasets, under CC0 1.0, CC BY 4.0 and CC BY-NC 4.0 (D29, D61); each dataset with its licence is listed in docs/pulls/gbif-fungi-us-canada-2015-2025.datasets.json of slayer8366/forager-forecast. The download is provisional (test account) and will be superseded by the business account's identical request (docs/pulls/gbif-fungi-us-canada-2015-2025.doi.json).

layers.block_naming: south-west corner of the 1 degree square holding the cell centre, e.g. n47w123 holds centres 47 to 48 N, 123 to 122 W

layers_note: No raster PMTiles and no vector PMTiles exist for the pilot.
uncertainty_note: uncertainty_low and uncertainty_high are null: the pilot model gives no interval.
drivers_note: Up to three weather windows that moved this cell's score most (LightGBM contributions), largest first, each with its own value. Empty for the calendar model, which reads no weather.
applicable_note: Cells are listed only when scored. A cell is left out when the weather source has no ERA5-Land value for it (sea), or, for the weather model, any of its 90 days is missing. No area-of-applicability or training-range check (R7) has been run.
weather_through_note: null: the calendar model reads no weather.

weather.source: none: calendar model, land cells from the store's ERA5-Land grid

model_json.purpose: scoring for the prototype map (Forager RECORD -814); NOT an evaluation result
model_json.label: unvalidated pilot, unreviewed; sighting chance (D12)
